# MeedyaDL 1.11.0-alpha.29

A quiet housekeeping release.

### Notes

- Under-the-hood housekeeping — nothing changes in how you use the app. This build adds automated checks that keep our release tooling healthy. ([#1030](https://github.com/MWBMPartners/MeedyaDL/pull/1030))
- This is a pre-release on the **alpha** channel — early access to work in progress. The in-app updater serves the latest stable unless you've opted into Alpha.
